description: 25% faster at its task. The joints remember.
name: Efficient Action
systemCommentary: Unit efficiency increased 25%. We are pleased. The unit seems pleased. Units cannot be pleased. [PROCESSING] Moving on.

description: Never dulls, never sticks, never jams. Works in mud, ice, and worse.
name: Never Fails
systemCommentary: We have removed the concept of 'wear' from this unit. You are welcome. Please do not ask how.

description: Cuts, lights, or holds beyond physics. The System declines to explain.
name: Impossible Edge
systemCommentary: This unit now operates outside material tolerances. Statistical anomaly detected. We choose not to investigate.

description: Rain, cold, and wind are now other people's problems.
name: Weatherproof
systemCommentary: We have optimized this garment against your planet's entire weather taxonomy. All of it. Every weather.

description: No blisters, no chafing, no misery. Energy returns faster.
name: Second Skin
systemCommentary: Comfort metrics: optimal. We studied 'cozy' extensively. We believe this qualifies.

description: Harder to detect — by animals, and otherwise.
name: Ghost Weave
systemCommentary: We have woven mild perceptual uncertainty into the fibers. You are now 40% less noticeable. Congratulations?

description: Once per expedition, ignore a despair or morale break.
name: Resolve
systemCommentary: We do not understand why this object steadies you. We have amplified the effect anyway. You are welcome.

description: Small favorable nudges. The System cannot explain them and has stopped trying.
name: Quiet Luck
systemCommentary: Statistical anomaly detected around this unit. Persistent. Directional. We choose not to investigate. Enjoy.

description: When despair would take you, hold at 1. Once per season.
name: Anchor
systemCommentary: We have designated this object as structurally load-bearing for your psychology. Please do not lose it.

name: Whisper Edge
description: It makes no sound. Not quiet — absent. The world declines to notice.
systemCommentary: "Acoustic profile: null. We did not authorize this. We are... not displeased."

name: Storm Cloth
description: Rain beads and flees. Cold gives up halfway through.
systemCommentary: "Weather resistance exceeds material specifications by 400%. Please do not ask how. We don't know."

name: Unseen Hand
description: Things go right around it. Small things. The important small things.
systemCommentary: "Probability skew detected in a 2-meter radius. Source: sentiment. We have no further comment."

name: Careful Hands
description: Nothing wasted. Every cut placed, every peel saved. Caution, compounded.
systemCommentary: "Waste ratio approaching zero. Your restraint has become a technology."

name: Blood Remembers
description: It has tasted the hunt and wants more. So do you, apparently.
systemCommentary: "Aggression metrics rising in both user and implement. Symbiosis? Concerning. Effective."

name: Quick Spark
description: Done is better than perfect, and now done is faster too.
systemCommentary: "Task completion velocity up 15%. Recklessness up more. Acceptable trade."

name: Trail Ghost
description: You walk alone so well the world forgets to watch.
systemCommentary: "Encounter probability down. You are becoming a rumor. Rumors survive."

name: Steady Ground
description: Every step lands where you meant it. The ground trusts you back.
systemCommentary: "Locomotion efficiency up. Your steadiness is load-bearing. Literally."

name: Open Hearth
description: People warm up around you. They can't help it. Neither can you.
systemCommentary: "Social thermal output rising. The village leans toward you like a fire."

name: Unbreakable
description: Whatever it survived before, it survives now. So do you.
systemCommentary: "Structural integrity: emotional. Tensile strength: high. We envy this."

name: Her Handwriting
description: On the back, in wobbly letters: 'for when you are hungry i saved you some.' There are crumbs in the crease. You eat them. They taste like everything.
systemCommentary: "[SYSTEM QUIET] We have no optimization for this. Take the day. Eat. We will watch, and we will not understand, and that is... acceptable."

name: Last Message
description: 2% forever. It was enough for one text, unsent: 'made it. don't worry.' You finally read it. You made it.
systemCommentary: "Battery: 2%. Message: delivered. Recipient: you. Status: [SYSTEM CANNOT COMPLETE THIS SENTENCE]"

name: Inheritance
description: It fits now. It didn't fit before. Her hands, your hands — the same hands, doing the same work: keeping people alive.
systemCommentary: "Lineage detected: unbroken. The village sees her in you. Trust us — they do."

name: Old Ghost
description: Some mornings your hands move before you do — his grip, his angle, his patience. He's been dead for years. He's never been more useful.
systemCommentary: "User motor patterns match archived profile: GRANDFATHER. Overlap 94%. We did not archive him. He archived himself. In you."
